$comment: UOB's published page on adding its cards to mobile wallets with Digital Token authentication (Decisions 5 and 7). A published page, not contract terms. One clause per overview paragraph, per part, and per FAQ question with its answer; the page's navigation, its second copy of the setup part, the FAQ group headings and the cookie notice are left out. Each capture whose text differs is a version; effective_from is the capture date (the page shows no date of its own). The page's own start date ('From 1 July 2025') goes on the wallet_provisioning request row, not here. From the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine (capture 8 August 2025; fetched 24 November 2026). The last capture before 1 October 2025.

document.title: Add your cards securely to mobile wallet with Digital Token

markers.at: ^\s*From 1 July 2025, authentication through SMS One-Time-Password \(OTP\) when you add your UOB Card\(s\) to your mobile wallets such as Apple Pay, Google Pay and Samsung Pay will be progressively changed to Digital Token Authentication via the UOB TMRW app to protect you against potential scams\.\s*$

^\s*Please note that SMS OTP authentication will no longer be available\. Customers without digital access or digital token will be notified to set up digital access and digital token before proceeding with mobile wallet provisioning\.\s*$
^\s*Setting up your Digital Token\s*$
^\s*Setting up your Digital Token\s*$
^\s*How to authenticate your mobile wallet provisioning request via Digital Token\?\s*$
^\s*Frequently Asked Questions \(FAQs\)\s*$
^\s*Authenticate your mobile wallet provisioning request with Digital Token\s*$
^\s*How do I add my UOB Cards into my mobile wallet \(Apple Pay, Google Pay & Samsung Pay\) via digital token authentication\?\s*$
^\s*Can I opt out of Digital Token authentication & continue to validate via SMS One-Time Password \(OTP\) authentication when I add my UOB Card to a mobile wallet\?\s*$
^\s*What happens if I do not have mobile banking access & digital token set up\?\s*$
^\s*Can I add my UOB Cards into my mobile wallet if I have UOB TMRW app installed but digital token is NOT set up\?\s*$
^\s*Can I add the same UOB Card to mobile wallets on multiple devices \(such as tablet or other mobile phones\) which do not have UOB TMRW app & digital token set up\?\s*$
^\s*I am a supplementary cardholder\. Can I add my UOB Supplementary Card into my mobile wallet\?\s*$
^\s*Why can’t I add my card to my mobile wallet\?\s*$
^\s*Why am I not receiving any push notification to verify my request\?\s*$
^\s*How do I turn on notifications on my mobile device\?\s*$
^\s*Digital Token\s*$
^\s*What is a Digital Token\?\s*$
^\s*Who can sign up for Digital Token\? How do I set it up\?\s*$
^\s*I forgot my Digital Token code\. What should I do\?\s*$
^\s*I’ve changed my mobile device\. Do I need to set up my digital token again\?\s*$
^\s*My mobile device is lost or stolen\. What should I do\?\s*$
^\s*We use cookies to improve and customise your browsing experience\. You are deemed to have consented to our cookies policy if you continue browsing our site\.\s*$
